about: THEIR in-game tooltip, as text only (the words and numbers the planner printed - no code, no art), hovered on every base row of six runewords in the planner's Base tab for a level 99 Sorceress, 2026-09-26 (headless Chrome, real mouse). A runeword's property block is stored once ('props'); a base whose block differs carries its own. Their full list for a base = head + props. The law normalises the en dash to '-' and whitespace, nothing else.
